sourceRecords.title: 14 · Crevasse and nothic · area 8
read: The worked stone gives way to a raw split in the earth. Two narrow bridges cross the dark gap, and the space below is difficult to make out.

The break in the cavern floor divides your approach into separate stretches of ground. Its edges and any visible crossing deserve a careful look before someone moves ahead. You can stop to judge the drop or keep to the near side while deciding what you want to investigate.

brief: SAME cavern, two rough support columns, narrow deep fissure and TWO arched wooden plank bridges WITHOUT rails. ONE nothic is now visible beside a west-side stone column: a hunched lean green-skinned aberration, ONE enormous central eye, elongated clawed arms, naked rough-scaled anatomy. Small humanoid scale, not a towering beholder, no eyestalks or mouth in its eye. It watches warily rather than attacking. Hidden chest and body below remain out of view, no glowing magical crevasse.
